data.name: Word Cubes
data.detailed_description:
Word Cubes is a challenging 3D word game that reimagines the classic tile-placing experience on a three-dimensional grid. Place letter tiles across a vibrant cubic board, form intersecting words in multiple directions, and outscore your CPU opponent in this addictive puzzle game.

**Key Features:**

• **3D Gameplay** — Place tiles across three axes on a striking cubic board. Think in three dimensions as you build words along the X, Y, and Z axes, creating unexpected intersections and strategic depth you won't find in traditional games.

• **Strategic Tile Placement** — With premium bonus squares including Double Word, Triple Word, Double Letter, and Triple Letter multipliers scattered across the cube's faces, every placement is a calculated decision. Maximize your score by controlling the most valuable spaces.

• **Standard Letter Distribution** — Play with familiar letter values and frequencies matching classic English word games. Rare letters like Q, Z, and J carry higher point values, while common letters like E and A offer safer, lower-risk plays.

• **Smart AI Opponents** — Challenge yourself against adjustable difficulty AI. The computer opponent analyzes the board, forms high-scoring words, and plays strategically to test your skills.

• **Tactical Swaps** — Running low on options? Swap tiles from your rack back into the bag for a fresh draw. Manage your resources wisely — passing costs you a turn but can set up bigger plays later.

• **Clean 3D Visuals** — Rotate, zoom, and inspect the board from any angle. The polished 3D presentation makes it easy to see connections across all three axes and plan your next move.

• **Instant Word Validation** — Real-time feedback shows whether your formed words are valid as you place tiles. The pending score display keeps you informed of your potential points before committing to a play.

**How to Play:**

Select a tile from your rack of seven, then move the cursor across the 3D grid to position it. Lock your placement direction and commit your word. Form words along any axis — horizontal, vertical, or depth — and create cross-words for bonus points. Your first move must cover the center of the cube; subsequent plays must connect to existing tiles.

The game ends when all tiles are exhausted, or players have passed too many times. The player with the highest score wins.
